The meeting screen stops asking where to save. There was never anything left to choose.

## Starting a meeting is one question now

Pick the customer — that's the whole filing story. The 存到 section is gone: the recording lands under the customer you picked, or under 還沒歸戶 if you picked no one, and no folder dropdown appears anywhere on the way into a meeting.

## Sharing to your team is its own thing

If you're signed in with sync on, a single "also share to an organization" row takes the save section's place — and it now composes with the customer instead of fighting it. Previously, choosing a team destination quietly moved your own copy out of the customer's records; now the recording stays filed under its customer and the team gets a copy on top. The same choice lives in Settings as a standing default, retitled to say what it actually does.
